name: crashtest-site
description: crashtest attacks the site it actually ships: headers claim audit, CSP canary bypass attempts, HTML secret leakage, sitemap truth audit, manifest icon checks, robots.txt self-sabotage, version-function robustness + cache poisoning + shape-flap burst, taxonomy probes (abuse never 5xx, sad-path bodies stay impersonal), + session probes (a cookie-less site must mint zero cookies; a forged cookie is never adopted or reflected), an authz probe (nothing ships advertising a privileged surface; role-claim bodies flip nothing), + a proto-hygiene battery (HEAD mirrors GET on every asset route; bare-shape query chaos never takes an asset serve down). Self-contained: bundles its own attacks and registry double.
